vocabulary.passport: Passport bio page (identity page of the passport)
vocabulary.photo: Recent colour photo of the applicant
vocabulary.bank_statement: Bank statement of the last 3 months, applicant's or sponsor's name
vocabulary.return_ticket: Return or onward flight ticket out of Indonesia
vocabulary.application_letter: Letter applying for the visa, signed by the applicant or prepared by us for signature
vocabulary.sponsor_letter: Letter from the sponsor (company or person) guaranteeing or supporting the applicant
vocabulary.invitation_letter: Letter or invitation from an Indonesian body, company or organiser explaining the purpose and relationship
vocabulary.family_tie_letter: Letter from an Indonesian spouse or parent explaining the family tie and the activities in Indonesia
vocabulary.family_card: Indonesian family card (Kartu Keluarga) of the Indonesian relative
vocabulary.reentry_permit: Permit to return to the country of application, for stateless people or holders of a non-national travel document
vocabulary.current_stay_permit: The applicant's current visa or stay permit
vocabulary.work_permit_rptka: Manpower-ministry approval for the foreign worker's position (RPTKA)
vocabulary.share_ownership_proof: Proof of the applicant's own shareholding in the Indonesian company, registered with the investment ministry
vocabulary.establishment_decree: Law-ministry decree approving the company's establishment
vocabulary.company_bank_statement: Company current-account statements of the last 2 months
vocabulary.income_proof: Proof of income (salary account record or allowance)
vocabulary.employment_contract_foreign: Employment agreement with a company established outside Indonesia
vocabulary.birth_certificate: Birth certificate (reserved: appears only in candidates left out)
vocabulary.support_letter: Evidence of the applicant's tie to Indonesia: a letter from an institution, or from an Indonesian spouse or parent
